hypothesis: Earlier sensor-based updates may change executed wheel/body response before subsequent impacts. Benefit unproven; fixed ramp/40ms confirmation can remove the expected timing advantage.

fixed.obstacle: rigid capsule, diameter6mm, cylindrical section4m, x3.1m, yaw+8deg
fixed.only_between_arm_configuration_delta: profile full/reactive and opt-in20ms governor cadence; common20ms world transactions in ALL arms; environment/scoring/follower remain100ms
fixed.note: Inherited config/metadata contain legacy radius/mesh tags. Preserve bytes; effective collision is verified SDF. PPO/reward fields are inert in this baseline evaluation.

initialization.command_ownership: one inline evaluation governor; no second ROS speed governor

outcome_windows.primary: first recorded positive-obstacle manifold +0.05s to +3.0s; fixed for both arms; not guaranteed to remove entire first-impact tail
outcome_windows.whole_route: unchanged first control input through final action end
outcome_windows.recovery: existing concurrent CRUISE scale>=0.98, executed v>=0.392m/s, body v>=0.95 precontact median sustained0.3s after contact end
outcome_windows.negative_control: precontact approach and first50ms only when every GT/joint interpolation support precedes the first reduced executed command; otherwise mark contaminated/unavailable, never use it as a causal negative control

measurement.native: Keep replay and native scores unchanged, separate namespace
measurement.vertical: Unfiltered original IMU header-time samples; sample RMS and peak; raw values retained; existing signal_stats coverage>=0.98
measurement.slip: gt_timestamp_series + integrate at original GT stamps; interpolate joints only, maxgap10.001ms, no extrapolation; same ratio clipping/denominator; slip_square_per_m units s/m, not joules
measurement.sensitivity: Retain original-GT slip plus existing20ms grid and+10ms shifted grid on same windows. Require same direction for primary slip effect; report all. No downsampling IMU to10Hz for scoring, no favorable grid selection.
measurement.protection: No spike removal, no zero imputation, no changes to historical studies/models or parameter configuration

rearming: Unchanged: HOLD can retrigger and restart its timer;0.8-1.0s limits apply per trigger, not to a whole multi-trigger contact sequence. Log all event-count changes.
feature_semantics: Latest hardware state each decision; trailing100ms IMU. Target acceleration uses100ms decision-feedback history, not20ms. Same physical filter constant; discretization/time-quantization effects are part of cadence, no per-frame timer reinterpretation.
initialization_semantics: Match empty IMU summary at initial command. Target-acceleration history warmup <=100ms explicitly marked, before fixed800ms startup; never load pre-reset history.
fairness: Four triads, 4 observations per arm. Position counts1/1/2 per arm; exact3-position balance impossible with4 triads. Report order, seed blocks and individual repeats. Same seed is not same caster/contact state.

analysis.pairs: 4 intact seed+repeat pairs per contrast,2 per block; never treat overlapping frames as independent trials
analysis.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap10000, RNG20261020, resample intact triads within each block; equal-weight blocks; descriptive intervals with no power/coverage guarantee
analysis.missing: All12 assigned attempts remain; retain failures/spikes/null. No zero fill, success-only averages or finite-only CI. Missing required pair makes its estimand/CI unavailable.
analysis.sampling: Original GT-header slip/joint interpolation, native replay and existing20ms/+10ms sensitivity retained; no favorable-grid selection
analysis.timing: Use full governor_update_trace.csv for20ms arm, not coarse100ms control_trace. Causal drive receipt/publication checks; distinguish command/target timing from body/joint response; preserve sensor age/support and whole contact sequence.
analysis.observed_body_response: Report precontact and contact-before-command differences, event-aligned body/wheel trajectories and causal snapshots before command/each subsequent loaded manifold. A contact-induced dip before command is not governor latency or benefit. No claimed identified actuator latency.
analysis.phase_windows: Retain route and tc+50ms..tc+3s outcomes, first50ms fixed diagnostic, crossing/whole-sequence/recovery. First50ms is NOT necessarily a negative control when20ms arm can act inside it. Pre-intervention comparison uses tc to earliest relative executed command of either arm; before both interventions. No global-x alignment.
analysis.stopping: Hard stop on setup/provenance/sensor/cadence/physics/cleanup fault; ordinary task failures retained with no replacement. At12 attempts stop. Mixed/uncertain findings remain inconclusive; no automatic next pilot.

integration_checks: First attempts are within12, no separate smoke. Exactly5 micro-decisions per100ms score interval in fast arm, none at endpoint100ms (next step owns it); same total100 physics steps. Native score/IMU accumulation once per100ms; full trace and native replay mandatory. First PI and20ms health/metadata closure checks must pass before subsequent assigned attempt; health sidecar overflow/error/truncation is integrity failure. No observer timing duration threshold changes scoring. Both process readiness/reset/end/closure and provenance mandatory; all arms use isolated joint/GT authority with no legacy fill. First live checks, if separately funded, stay inside the new budget.

observer_health.change: In-memory monotonic callback and conversion/encode/write/flush timing, sidecar written after collection. Same raw payload, QoS, sampling, controller and scoring.
observer_health.performance_thresholds: No new duration gate; missing/truncated/overflow/error health data is an integrity fault.
observer_health.parent_batch: All earlier cadence batches remain closed; this contract has no released slots
observer_health.fixed_scenarios: Same77600/77601 scenarios, separately recorded repetitions; no unseen/generalization claim
observer_health.shutdown_revision: Both recorder processes own orderly close; offline and synthetic ROS only. Gazebo integration remains unvalidated.

acquisition.readiness: Both source-bound processes fresh <=100ms, live status <=2s; discovery before reset; exact reset/end ACK, no world steps while waiting;10s wall deadline, no retry
acquisition.closure: Both closed manifests/status + primary health + capture CRC/SHA/epoch; immutable source hashes; no legacy metadata masquerade or gap fill
acquisition.epoch_selection: Validate selected reset epoch before deriving view. Pre-reset samples equal to start timestamp stay raw, never support current windows. Missing current streams, wrong sequence or regression still fail; no metric/coverage change.
acquisition.scoring: Unchanged100ms native replay, GT-header sampling/joint interpolation,98percent coverage EACH original window,20ms/+10ms sensitivity and2s stopping
